folders_created.description: The folders created before the failure, in tree order. They stay.

consumed.description: Every ID raised from last_id for the batch, ascending: consumed[i] was tasks[i]'s. Empty when the failure came before last_id was raised.

ids.description: The tasks created before the failure: the first len(ids) tasks, in input order. May be empty.

refs.description: The refs of the tasks in ids, and their IDs.
